name: Pitlane
description: Pitlane autoscales ephemeral self-hosted GitHub Actions runners on a Docker host, with a web UI. Each job gets a fresh runner while Docker layers, package caches and toolchains stay warm in long-lived Docker-in-Docker slots, so CI runs faster than on GitHub-hosted runners. It uses GitHub's scale set API (no public URL needed) and creates its own GitHub App in one click.

notes.text: Open the web UI, enter the setup token saved in ~/pitlane.creds inside the container, then click Create GitHub App and install it on your account or organization.
Each parallel job needs roughly 2-4 GB of RAM: set the number of slots and the memory limit per job in Settings to fit the container's resources.
Every job controls a privileged Docker-in-Docker daemon inside the container. Do not run untrusted pull requests from forks on it.
